candidate.name: @clossys/qa
candidate.jobQuestion: Is this work fit for the intended user or spec, independently of whoever made it?
candidate.closeCondition: Independent consumer evidence shows the position's owned metric meets its setpoint over the declared review cadence. QA must not compute that metric itself.

metric.name: independent fitness keep rate
metric.formula: candidates independently kept for the named user or spec / all candidates independently fitness-reviewed before seal or land

boundary.owns: Independent fitness review against a named user or spec, including synthetic target-user inhabit for pre-auth pages.
excludes: judging whether a change satisfies declared operating rules
